summary: Proactive agents must decide whether, when, and how far to assist without an explicit request. Existing evaluations often rely on automated scores or binary verdicts, offering limited human diagnosis of evidence use and intervention quality.
takeaways: Recorded reasoning tokens and retrieval rounds measure the effort behind these responses.
To address these gaps, we introduce HALO, Human-Grounded GrAnular EvaLuation of PrOactive Agents.
Scenarios require agents to retrieve evidence from structured databases or unstructured documents before judging whether assistance is warranted and choosing its scope.
